summary: Frontend-only browser test (375x667) of the standalone Prajeta Customer Expo app against the PRODUCTION backend https://fleetride-hub.emergent.host. Every /api call went to fleetride-hub.emergent.host. No CORS errors and no failed requests. PASS: login with demo customer 9000000003 / 123456 lands on /customer. Home ReferralCard shows code PRJ8YK6Z. The WhatsApp share (api.whatsapp.com/send) and the More share (navigator.share) both contain <origin>/?ref=PRJ8YK6Z. Opening /?ref=PRJ8YK6Z saves pending_ref, and this works logged in and logged out (it survives the redirect to /login and the login itself). Quote service /book/monthly has no coupon field, makes no fare call and keeps pending_ref. Fixed-price /book/hourly sends a fare-estimate with coupon=PRJ8YK6Z. The backend returns 400 'You can't use your own referral code'. The app shows a toast, clears the field (button back to 'Apply'), refetches the fare without a coupon (Rs 518 total, 'Review & Pay Rs 104 Advance' enabled) and removes pending_ref. An invalid link code (zzzbad99 becomes ZZZBAD99, 'Invalid or expired coupon') is also auto-cleared. A manually typed bad coupon is NOT auto-cleared: it shows the fare error and the submit button is disabled, as designed. Logged-out /support makes 0 /api/tickets calls and shows 'No tickets yet' right away. No bookings were created on production. Issues found: (1) fare is estimated with the raw `time` param instead of the displayed effTime, which can hide the night surcharge; (2) the rejection toast uses the success style; (3) contact name is empty after a hard load or deep link; (4) GET /api/bookings/pending-review returns 404 and is retried/polled repeatedly; (5) the fare queryKey is missing `date`. No deprecated Expo packages detected.

minor.issue: Returns 404 for the logged-in demo customer, who has no pending review. RatingPrompt polls it every 20s and react-query retries 3x on each failure, so every home load shows 4x 404 console errors. Either the backend should return 200 {booking:null}, or the query should set retry:false and treat 404 as null. Could not inspect the response body because the demo OTP got rate-limited (see below).

After 4 sends within about 3 minutes, the demo number 9000000003 returns 'Too many OTP requests. Please wait 10 minutes.' Testers/reviewers using the demo account can lock themselves out. Consider exempting demo phones.

ui_bugs.issue: toast(msg) at app/book/[serviceId].tsx:74 uses the default 'ok' kind, so 'You can't use your own referral code' shows with a green checkmark (success style). Use toast(msg, 'err').

useState(user?.name ?? '') at app/book/[serviceId].tsx:43 runs before auth is ready on a hard load or deep link (e.g. /book/hourly opened directly or from a shared link), so 'Contact name' is empty. In-app navigation pre-fills 'Ananya Shah (Demo Customer)' correctly. Sync the field with a useEffect when user loads.

integration_issues.issue: The fare query (app/book/[serviceId].tsx:52-54) sends `time` (URL param or default '10:00'), but the UI shows and submit() books `effTime` (the first future slot when today's 10:00 has passed). Seen in the browser: /book/hourly and /book/night opened directly showed 'Today, 8:30 PM' while the fare request had time '10:00'. Curl to the production backend confirms the price depends on time: a 23:00 start adds 'Night surcharge (10 PM - 6 AM)' (total 77750 vs 51790 paise). So users can be shown a fare without the night surcharge and then booked with it. Use effTime in both the queryKey and the body. This affects direct links, /book/full-day from 'schedule later', quick rebook and the referral deep-link flow.

integration_issues.flow: Fare estimate refresh on date change
integration_issues.issue: The fare queryKey ['fare', service.id, cityId, time, hrs, days, appliedCoupon] leaves out `date` even though date is in the request body, so changing the date chip does not refetch. Add date (and effTime) to the key.

action_items: HIGH: app/book/[serviceId].tsx fare query: replace `time` with `effTime` in the queryKey and body, and add `date` to the queryKey. Compute effTime before the query (move the slots/effTime calculation above useQuery).
LOW: app/book/[serviceId].tsx:74 call toast(msg, 'err') for the rejected referral code.
LOW: pre-fill the contact name when user becomes available, e.g. useEffect(() => { if (user?.name && !name) setName(user.name) }, [user]).
LOW: RatingPrompt pending-review query: set retry:false (or map 404 to {booking:null}) to stop the 404 retry storm. Check why production returns 404 for a customer with no pending review.
INFO: the demo OTP number is rate-limited on production (4 sends in about 3 min). Consider whitelisting demo phones.
critical_code_review_comments: src/referral.ts: capture/validate regex ^[A-Z0-9-]{3,20}$ with uppercase normalisation works. Pending ref is kept for quote services and only cleared on a referral/coupon rejection or after a successful booking. Good.
The auto-apply effect fires one extra fare call with coupon=null before AsyncStorage resolves (3 calls per screen open). Harmless, but it could be avoided by waiting until the pending ref is loaded.

If the user taps 'Remove' on an auto-applied valid friend's code, linkCode stays set but pending_ref is not cleared, so it will auto-apply again on the next booking screen. That is acceptable and arguably desired.
No deprecated Expo packages (expo-av, expo-barcode-scanner, expo-background-fetch) were found, and no react-native SafeAreaView imports.
